items.title: SanDisk Stock Jumped 11% on S&P 100 News. Here’s What the Street Says.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIndex Bid: SanDisk stock jumped 11% on Thursday after joining the S&P 100. Street Split: TIKR tracks 25 analysts on SanDisk stock, splitting 16 buys, 4 outperforms, 3 holds, 1 underperform and 1 sell, while the $2,125 mean target sits 19% above Thursday’s $1,792 close.

items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Stock May Be Undervalued After Its Huge Three Year Run
items.summary: Western Digital has been one of the strongest movers in large-cap tech over the past few years, so the real question now is whether the current share price can still be explained by the earnings backing it. With the stock closing around US$441.36 and expectations building around high-capacity storage for AI workloads, you need to know if the recent story around profits is enough to support that kind of valuation. items.title: Up 500% In 12 Months, This is Where Micron Is Headed
items.summary: Micron just delivered the most jaw-dropping quarter any US semiconductor company has posted this cycle, yet the stock is sliding and analysts are at war over what comes next. Where the smart money lands may surprise you.

items.title: Micron Just Built One Memory Stick That Replaces Four. Is MU Stock a Buy?
items.summary: Micron just pulled off a server memory breakthrough that has both AMD and Intel on board, but the revenue from it sits two fiscal years away while the stock already trades near all-time highs. Here is what that gap means for anyone deciding whether to buy now.

items.title: Prediction: Seagate Could Be a Surprisingly Big Winner From the AI Boom
items.summary: Hard drives look like a relic next to the glamorous AI chip trade, yet Seagate shareholders have watched the stock surge nearly 300% in a single year. The real question is whether the forces driving that run have staying power or whether the easy money is already gone.

items.title: SanDisk Jumps 6% as Storage Bid Concentrates in One Name; Western Digital Rises 3%, Micron Ticks Up
items.summary: Something is pulling SanDisk sharply higher this Friday morning while the rest of the memory sector barely stirs, and no earnings release, filing, or analyst note explains why buyers are concentrating so heavily in one name.

items.title: Western Digital vs. Sandisk: Which Storage Stock is the Better Bet?
items.summary: WDC and SNDK offer distinct paths to AI-driven storage growth, with divergent margins, risks and exposure to HDDs versus NAND flash.

items.title: 2 Volatile Stocks on Our Watchlist and 1 We Question
items.summary: Market swings can be tough to stomach, and volatile stocks often experience exaggerated moves in both directions. While many thrive during risk-on environments, many also struggle to maintain investor confidence when the ride gets bumpy.
